But she's pretty rough and is now just a raccoon ranch.

This is an odd-shaped parcel on the inside of a curve on the Tobin-Alpha Road. If you're considering building on this one, you may want to check with the local zoning folks to be sure the dimensions allow it after deduction whatever road right-of-way is here. This is a nicely wooded uplands parcel.
